title: Lesson 1 Quiz: Chart Types, Timeframes, and Trend Structure

questions.text: According to top-down analysis, which timeframe is primarily used to identify the overall trend and major support/resistance levels?
questions.explanation: Higher timeframes such as 4-hour or daily charts reveal the dominant trend and key levels.

questions.text: In a sideways market, price makes higher highs and higher lows.
questions.explanation: A sideways or ranging market shows roughly equal highs and lows, not higher highs and higher lows.
